scenario: Operation Red Robin continuity. Every included slot reads this document and proposes the next heading from the same log.
objective: Agree one shared heading for Landing Stone continuity and name one risk before the round limit.

rules.text: Strict order follows the slot registry: free-tier slots first, then paid slots that are enabled. A round is one turn from each included slot. The engine never skips an included slot.
Each turn stays within the word limit. A leading demo banner line is not counted.
Each turn stays within the character limit. A leading demo banner line is not counted.
Each turn contains a HEADING: line and a RISK: line.
Each turn includes at least one objective word: continuity, landing, or shared.
The first turn says “opening turn”. Every later turn cites the previous speaker by name, so every slot is using the same log.
A turn must not contain an API key, a bearer token, or the phrases “password” or “secret key”.
Disagreement stays on the heading. A turn must not insult another slot.
